We're kicking off AP onboarding for the new engagement (PO 4098 attached). A few questions to make sure our payment process works smoothly:

- Preferred invoice delivery: we can accept (A) individual signed PDF invoices emailed to ap@veloxsys.com, or (B) e-invoice drops via SFTP (we'd pick up UBL/UBL-PEPPOL-ready XML) with a monthly CSV of line items. Which option does Redwood support?

- PO exceptions: our AP requires invoices to reference the PO number exactly and include the supplier remit ID. If you have a sample XML (UBL) schema or a sample invoice payload, please share so we can validate ingestion.

Our preference is SFTP + consolidated monthly statement (one CSV that contains all invoice line items for the month) plus archived signed PDFs for audit. That reduces manual processing on our side.

Can you confirm feasibility and an estimated onboarding lead time?

Hi Sally — thanks for the clear note and the PO. We're happy to support the SFTP + monthly aggregation approach you outlined; that's actually our recommended flow for customers who want lower transaction noise and prefer a single statement for AP reconciliation. A few specifics so we can align the onboarding work: 

1) File formats & payloads
  - We support individual signed PDFs (for buyers that need human-readable copies) and UBL-style XML payloads for automated ingestion. I'll attach our sample UBL (sample-invoice-ubl.xml) and the XSD we validate against (redwood-einvoice-xsd-v1.2.xsd).
  - For the monthly statement, we deliver a CSV with one line per invoice line item (columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, net_amount, vat_rate, vat_amount, total_amount, remit_entity).

2) VAT / remit entity
  - Please confirm the remit entity name and VAT number you want reflected on the invoice (this determines whether we apply reverse-charge or VAT on our side). If Velox is the reverse-charge recipient for the two items, we'll mark those lines with VAT=0 and include a reverse-charge note in the invoice XML and PDF.

3) SFTP details & cadence
  - We'll need hostname, user/key, preferred directory path, and whether you expect GPG encryption of files in transit. Typical cadence we see: daily drops for live ingestion + a consolidated monthly archive on the 2nd business day of each month. If you prefer only monthly drops, that's also doable but will delay acknowledgements.

4) PO reference & PO validation
  - We will include the PO number on header and line-level elements in the XML. Our ingestion will reject invoices that don't match PO format exactly; please confirm whether your PO numbers have a hyphen or any suffix (eg. 4098 or 4098-UK).

Next steps: I'll loop in Naomi from Revenue Ops to prepare the onboarding checklist and the sample files. If you can confirm remit/VAT and SFTP connection details, we can target a pilot drop in ~10 business days.

Best,
